## Why

Hosted return passes and quality probes (G2 step 2, ACT-13; L3 CP-0) have
no least-privilege place to run: today they'd inherit broad workstation
or project credentials. This row gives them a one-off Cloud Run job on a
dedicated least-privilege identity with a read-only mount of the capture
store, a SELECT-only `sig_audit` login with a statement timeout that
writes a `probe-run/1` record per use (SIG-CONF-013), and a
`sig_recovery`-scoped login for P35.61's bounded apply once that role
deploys. After this row, no login exists with more than its job's rights.

## What ships

- **`ops/exec_host.toml` (`sig.exec-host/1`) +
  `ops/src/ops/exec_host.py` + `sig-ops exec-host
  plan|render|run|verify-describe|smoke`** — the declarative ephemeral
  host: `sig-exec-<purpose>-<stamp>` jobs on `sig-quality-probe-rt`,
  digest-pinned image only (ADR-111), `--command` + per-execution
  `--args`, one task / `maxRetries=0` / bounded timeout, the Cloud SQL
  connector on `sig-pg`, a gcsfuse `readonly=true` mount of
  `<project>-sig-restricted` (captures root `evidence/captures/`), an
  allow-listed `secret_env` set, `SIG_EXEC_JOB_NAME` injected from the
  generated name (never caller input), and a `finally` delete of exactly
  the created job — a `sig-exec-*` job at rest is a leaked cleanup that
  `iam diff` reports.
- **`ops/gcp/exec-host.sh`** — the windowed L1 leg: check-mode default;
  `prestate` (project IAM, SAs, run jobs, bucket IAM, secret IAM + list,
  the rendered declaration, sha256 sidecars) → `identity` → `secrets`
  (create-if-absent, never a value) → `bindings` → `smoke` (the first
  real run — asserts the mount is mounted read-only, the declared secret
  is present, `sig_audit`'s session posture, and writes exactly one
  `sig.probe-run/1` under `ops/probes/`) → `verify` (poststate + `iam
  diff --leg exec`) → `analysis` (read-only troubleshooter:
  off-prefix/bucket-scope create + every delete NOT_GRANTED, no access to
  unrelated `sig-pg-password`) → `rollback` (only what the leg provably
  created, the job by exact name).
- **`ops/src/ops/db_logins.py` + `sig-ops db-login plan|apply|verify`** —
  `LoginRole` declarations: `sig_audit` (LOGIN, NOBYPASSRLS/NOSUPERUSER/
  NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE, connlimit 4, member `sig_read_public`,
  `default_transaction_read_only=on`, `statement_timeout=60s`) and
  `sig_recovery_login` (connlimit 2, member of the pre-existing
  `sig_recovery` NOLOGIN group — the distinct `_login` name keeps L52's
  group shape); `sig_recovery` resolves as an alias. Apply is idempotent
  (skip CREATE, reassert); a missing prerequisite exits 42; verify
  reports pass/fail/**`not_evaluable`** — the NEW-16 grants are honestly
  not-evaluable until the deploy lands inside P34.46's slot.
- **`ops/gcp/db-logins.sh`** — `--check/--apply/--verify` ×
  `prestate/backup/apply/credential/verify/rollback/all` × `--role`;
  Cloud SQL Proxy; owner password + DSN in the environment only (HG-09 —
  never argv, files or logs); the AR-2 on-demand backup verified
  SUCCESSFUL before the first role statement; the `/health` stop-rule
  before any role mutation; password material generated and pushed
  through `gcloud secrets versions add --data-file=-`; L2 exits 42 when
  `sig_recovery` is absent.
- **`db/deploy|revert|verify/audit_login.sql` + `db/sqitch.plan`** — the
  catalog-only change after L59 (L44–52 untouched, C-10): creates both
  constrained logins, grants the memberships, and grants `sig_audit`
  SELECT on the two NEW-16 tables `sig_read_public` lacks
  (`ingest_run_capture`, `entity_identity_key`).
- **`ops/iam_identities.toml` + `iam_identities.py`** — `[[oneoff]]`
  `sig-exec` on `sig-quality-probe-rt`; the `exec` leg plans exactly six
  steps (SA create; `roles/cloudsql.client`; conditioned
  `objectViewer` on `evidence/captures/` (`p34-43-captures-readonly`);
  conditioned `objectCreator` on `ops/probes/` (`p34-43-probe-records`);
  the two secret accessors) and diffs only exec-owned state —
  `sig-exec-*` jobs at rest reported, services/jobs legs unchanged.
- **ADR-202** — credential choice (Secret-Manager-held generated password
  + accessor over Cloud SQL IAM DB auth; HG-09) and the ephemeral-host
  decisions; ADR-201 `## Status updates` append (its trigger fired);
  trigger register + BL-084 + Appendix F row (194 ADRs); **D-P34.43-1**
  (standing review of the two conditioned grants, owner P37.3) + e0

- Tests: `tests/ops/test_exec_host.py`, `test_db_logins.py`,

## Boundaries

**No production mutation ran or runs in this row.** Both live legs queue
with exit 42 (L1 window; L2 window + `live:P34.46`). The `audit_login`
sqitch change is committed but not deployed to hosted — the hosted plan
advance is P34.46's. No password, DSN or secret value appears in files,
argv or logs. Rollback removes only leg-created, prestate-proven
resources; the one-off job delete is name-checked against exactly the
name the run created.
